findings.description: The endpoint is served over HTTP instead of HTTPS, exposing transmitted data to interception.
findings.remediation: Obtain a TLS certificate and configure the server to redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS. Enable HSTS to prevent future downgrade attempts.
